# EPPS 6356

## Data Visualisation

**Fall 2026**

This page documents my coursework, visual analyses, and projects for EPPS 6356: Data Visualisation.

The course focuses on using data visualization as a tool for analysis and communication, with attention to evidence, perception, design choices, reproducibility, and critical interpretation.

:::

## About the Course

EPPS 6356 approaches data visualization as more than the production of charts. The coursework considers how visual representations shape interpretation and how visualization choices should be supported by appropriate data, analytical reasoning, and evidence.

As assignments are completed, this page will serve as an organized record of my work throughout the semester.

:::
